criteria.title: Pilot users reach the POV app
criteria.statement: Pilot users open the POV application through the App Connector, with no VPN.

criteria.title: Everyone else is denied
criteria.statement: Users outside the pilot group can't reach the POV application.
criteria.attest: From a device signed in as a user outside the pilot group, the POV app doesn't open.

criteria.title: Connector group is healthy
criteria.statement: The POV connector group has two healthy connectors for failover.

criteria.title: Admins reach a server through the PRA portal, with no VPN or client
criteria.statement: Pilot admins open an RDP or SSH session to a private server from a browser, through Privileged Remote Access, and only they can.

criteria.title: Attacks on the POV app are stopped (App Protection)
criteria.statement: App Protection inspects the pilot group's traffic to the private app and blocks web attacks such as cross-site scripting before they reach it.
